test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Something that can be carried easily.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Portable'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Portable** means a thing that can be moved or carried easily.

 ** • Example- **I always carry a portable computer with me.

 
• So, it is clear that the word** 'Portable'** can be used as a one-word substitution for **'Something that can be carried easily'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Convenient** means suitable or practical for a particular purpose.
 
• **Handy** means within easy reach of something; nearby.
 
• **Reachable** means able to be reached; accessible or achievable.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**
